note: Integrator entries for settings and grants that a package shipped without an (i) text (R1 rules, W1-FIX rules, B3 grants). Facts: docs/integration/R1.md, W1-FIX.md, RPT-B3.md and the seed SQL.

rule:pay_requests_on.title: Staff can ask for salary or an advance in the app
rule:pay_requests_on.does: When ON, a staff member sends an amount, a reason and the date it is needed from his own login. One responsible person decides: approve (on the date asked or another date) or reject with a reason.
rule:pay_requests_on.why: Requests are written down with who decided and when, instead of being asked by word of mouth.
rule:pay_requests_on.default: OFF. The advance and payroll screens work exactly as today.
rule:pay_requests_on.change: ON: the request screens open for staff and the approver. Payments already made never change.

rule:pay_requests_required.title: No salary or advance payment without an approved request
rule:pay_requests_required.does: When ON, a salary or advance payment to a staff member is refused unless an approved, due request backs it. One exception with a written reason is possible and is written to the Exceptions list.
rule:pay_requests_required.why: Stops verbal requests from turning into payments nobody approved.
rule:pay_requests_required.default: OFF. Payments are made as today.
rule:pay_requests_required.change: ON: the old screens still work when a matching request exists (it is linked and marked paid); otherwise they say a request is needed.

rule:pay_requests_required_kinds.title: Which payments need a request
rule:pay_requests_required_kinds.does: Chooses what the policy covers: both, advance only, or salary only.
rule:pay_requests_required_kinds.why: Lets the owner start with one kind of payment.
rule:pay_requests_required_kinds.change: Only matters while the policy 'No salary or advance payment without an approved request' is ON.

rule:pay_request_approver_mode.title: Who decides staff pay requests
rule:pay_request_approver_mode.does: The owner (default), everyone with one role, or one named person decides salary and advance requests. The owner can always decide. The person who asks never decides his own request.
rule:pay_request_approver_mode.why: One responsible person keeps decisions clear.
rule:pay_request_approver_mode.change: Set it on the Pay request settings screen; the role and person keys cannot be changed one by one from the browser.

rule:pay_request_approver_role.title: Approver role for staff pay requests
rule:pay_request_approver_role.does: The role code whose holders decide staff pay requests when the approver mode is role.
rule:pay_request_approver_role.change: Set through the Pay request settings screen, not directly.

rule:pay_request_approver_user.title: Approver person for staff pay requests
rule:pay_request_approver_user.does: The one named person who decides staff pay requests when the approver mode is user.
rule:pay_request_approver_user.change: Set through the Pay request settings screen, not directly.

rule:pay_request_exception_mode.title: Payment without an approved request: how an exception works
rule:pay_request_exception_mode.does: When the policy is ON: reason = the payer writes why and the payment goes through, owner = only the owner may, never = no exception. Every exception is a line in the Exceptions list.
rule:pay_request_exception_mode.why: Keeps the rare urgent payment possible but visible.
rule:pay_request_exception_mode.change: Only matters while the request policy is ON.

rule:pay_request_max_per_month.title: Most requests one staff member may send in a month
rule:pay_request_max_per_month.does: A number. Blank means no limit.
rule:pay_request_max_per_month.change: A request over the limit is refused with a clear message.

rule:pay_request_advance_ceiling.title: Highest open advance for one staff member
rule:pay_request_advance_ceiling.does: Open advances plus open advance requests plus the new one may not pass this amount. Blank means no ceiling.
rule:pay_request_advance_ceiling.why: Keeps the total owed by one person under a number the owner chose.
rule:pay_request_advance_ceiling.change: A request that would pass the amount is refused. Advances already given never change.

rule:party_requests_on.title: Staff can ask for a supplier payment in the app
rule:party_requests_on.does: When ON, staff with a place send a supplier payment request (supplier, amount, which bill or due, date needed). One responsible person decides.
rule:party_requests_on.why: Supplier payments get a written request and decision.
rule:party_requests_on.default: OFF. Supplier payments are made as today.
rule:party_requests_on.change: ON: the supplier request screen opens. Payments already made never change.

rule:party_requests_required.title: No supplier payment without an approved request
rule:party_requests_required.does: When ON, a supplier payment (not made with a bill) is refused unless an approved, due request backs it. The same exception rule applies as for staff pay.
rule:party_requests_required.change: ON: payments made on the old screen are accepted when a matching request exists.

rule:party_request_approver_mode.title: Who decides supplier payment requests
rule:party_request_approver_mode.does: Same as the staff setting (same), or the owner, one role, or one named person.
rule:party_request_approver_mode.why: A different approver for supplier payments is possible.
rule:party_request_approver_mode.change: Set it on the Pay request settings screen.

rule:party_request_approver_role.title: Approver role for supplier payment requests
rule:party_request_approver_role.does: The role code whose holders decide supplier payment requests when the mode is role.
rule:party_request_approver_role.change: Set through the Pay request settings screen, not directly.

rule:party_request_approver_user.title: Approver person for supplier payment requests
rule:party_request_approver_user.does: The one named person who decides supplier payment requests when the mode is user.
rule:party_request_approver_user.change: Set through the Pay request settings screen, not directly.

rule:void_follows_return_rules.title: A void must follow the return rules
rule:void_follows_return_rules.does: When ON, voiding a sale is refused if a full return of the same sale would be refused: outside the return window, a class set to never put back, or goods from an expired batch.
rule:void_follows_return_rules.why: Stops a void from being used to put goods back on the shelf when a return was refused.
rule:void_follows_return_rules.default: OFF, a void works as today.
rule:void_follows_return_rules.change: ON: the owner and holders of the return override right may still void with a written reason; that is logged and shown in the Exceptions list.

rule:supplier_pay_over_cumulative_days.title: Supplier payment limit over several days
rule:supplier_pay_over_cumulative_days.does: A number of days, 0 to 365. The supplier payment limit is compared with this payment plus what the same person already paid or has waiting for the same supplier in that many days.
rule:supplier_pay_over_cumulative_days.why: Stops splitting one big payment into small ones to stay under the limit.
rule:supplier_pay_over_cumulative_days.default: 0, the limit is checked per payment as today.
rule:supplier_pay_over_cumulative_days.change: Only used when the supplier payment limit has a number. The owner is never held.

grant:recall_manage.title: Open and run a recall case
grant:recall_manage.does: Lets a person open a recall case, add batches to it, mark what was done and close it. The affected-stock report shows who holds the batch.
grant:recall_manage.why: A recall needs one accountable person with a written record.
grant:recall_manage.default: Management, factory in-charge and storekeeper roles hold it; the owner always may.
grant:recall_manage.change: Giving it to another role lets that role open recall cases. Recorded cases are never deleted.

grant:stockout_log.title: Log a stockout (unmet demand)
grant:stockout_log.does: Lets a person write down that a customer wanted an item and it was not there.
grant:stockout_log.why: Shows lost demand that sales figures cannot show.
grant:stockout_log.default: Management, showroom manager, storekeeper and salesperson roles hold it.
grant:stockout_log.change: Entries can be voided with a reason, never deleted.

grant:supplier_terms_manage.title: Set agreed supplier prices and preferred suppliers
grant:supplier_terms_manage.does: Lets a person record the agreed price of an item with a supplier and the preferred or alternative suppliers of an item.
grant:supplier_terms_manage.why: Agreed prices are costs; the purchase price report compares them with what was paid.
grant:supplier_terms_manage.default: Purchasing and management roles hold it; the owner always may.
grant:supplier_terms_manage.change: Holders also see the agreed prices, which are otherwise hidden like any cost.
